comment:devDependencies: EXACT versions, no carets, because package-lock.json is gitignored and CI therefore re-resolves on every run. @playwright/test fixes the Chromium build, and @axe-core/playwright + axe-core fix the rule set: an axe minor ADDS rules, and a new rule reads as a NEW violation against tests/Browser/axe-baseline.json, i.e. red CI for a dependency bump nobody made.
comment:overrides: playwright-core: @axe-core/playwright pulls its own copy, pinning a DIFFERENT Chromium revision than @playwright/test does; two copies means `playwright install` and the runner can disagree about which browser build is required. axe-core: @axe-core/playwright depends on it as ~4.12.1, so a patch bump could still change rule behaviour under a pinned wrapper.
